steps.step: MD1 elimination: a heavy oscillator per channel coupled lambda (b + b^dag) O_A gives -(lambda^2/Delta) sum O_A^2; single channel with H_0 = 0 exact (completed square); with two noncommuting channels plus hopping the error falls ~1/Delta at fixed g

steps.step: MD2 mediator dictionary: the invariant bilinear B(u,v) = <z, u ^ v> on Lambda^2 V is symmetric, block-diagonal in the channels, nondegenerate on (10,1) and on (120,3), zero on (126,1) (complex rep): real 10 and real (120,3) mediators both feed the Delta N = 4 term, 126 mediators cannot

MD3 Theta_1's ray sum_A O_A^2 = sum_A (P_A + P_A^dag)^2 is exactly one REAL (10,1) mediator (|P_10|^2 plus the Delta N = 4 term through B_(10,1)); a complex (charge-2) 10 gives only sum {P_A, P_A^dag}; a real (120,3) adds |P_(120,3)|^2, so it cannot reproduce the ray; (126,1) mediators give only |P_126|^2; required quantum numbers: heavy real Spin(10) vector, spin singlet, Z4-odd, on-site coupling to the filtered pair operator (the QMC Hubbard-Stratonovich field has these quantum numbers but is only a rewriting, not a physical mode)
steps.detail: real (120,3) mediator feeds Delta N = 4: True

steps.step: MD4 source inventory: E8 roots split under D5 x D3 as 40 (+5 Cartan) = (45,1), 12 (+3) = (1,15), 60 = (10,6), 128 spinor = (16,4)+(16b,4b); the only bosonic Spin(10)-vector currents are (10,6): six family directions (an SO(6) vector) with no invariant vector under the family SO(3) -> no family-singlet elementary real 10; they are weight-1 (massless) seam currents, not heavy modes
